note: 第四十六轮（2026-11-15）：病历写着在用的西药，与本例已记录的病情相抵（说明书禁用或指南避免）时，注意事项写一条给患者的话（required-precautions.server.ts drug_condition_caution）。逐条带说明书或指南原文与出处；只写病历记录的事实与原文的意思，不写剂量。甲方 100 例 p100c-C034（慢性肾病3期、阿司匹林诱发喘息，自服双氯芬酸，注意事项只写「是否继续由医生决定」）、new45-n40（eGFR 17 仍服二甲双胍，注意事项一句没提）。

rules.sentence: 您的肾功能（eGFR {egfr}）已低于二甲双胍可以使用的范围（说明书：eGFR低于30禁用），请尽快就医由医生调整降糖方案，不要自行加量或换药

source.title: Metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets, prescribing information (DailyMed setid 96c8a89d-99db-24b1-e053-2a95a90ac2b8)
source.quote: Severe renal impairment (eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m2)；Discontinue metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets if the patient's eGFR later falls below 30 mL/minute/1.73 m2

rules.sentence: 您用阿司匹林后出现过{reaction}，{drug}与阿司匹林同属非甾体抗炎药，说明书写明这类患者禁用，请停用并尽快告知医生，止痛另由医生安排

source.title: Diclofenac sodium delayed-release tablets, prescribing information, CONTRAINDICATIONS (DailyMed setid 363764a0-e0a8-3e3f-e063-6294a90ad672)
source.quote: History of asthma, urticaria, or other allergic-type reactions after taking aspirin or other NSAIDs.

rules.sentence: 您肾功能已有减退，{drug}这类止痛药可加重肾损害（肾功能减退时应避免或不长期使用），请尽快告知医生由医生决定是否停用、改用其他止痛方法

source.title: National Kidney Foundation, adapted from KDIGO 2012 CKD guideline: medications and imaging studies risk
source.quote: Analgesics NSAIDS • Avoid when GFR <30 ml/min/1.73 m2 • Prolonged therapy is not recommended when GFR <60 ml/min/1.73 m2

labelSource.title: Diclofenac sodium delayed-release tablets, Renal Toxicity
labelSource.quote: Avoid the use of diclofenac in patients with advanced renal disease unless the benefits are expected to outweigh the risk of worsening renal function.

warfarinHerbal.sentence: 您正在服用华法林，开始或停服本方期间请按医嘱更频繁地复查INR，留意牙龈出血、皮下瘀斑、黑便或血尿{decrease}
warfarinHerbal.decreaseClause: ；方中{herbs}可能减弱华法林的抗凝作用

source.title: Warfarin sodium prescribing information, Drug Interactions: Botanical (Herbal) Products and Foods
source.quote: More frequent INR monitoring should be performed when starting or stopping botanicals.；Conversely, some botanicals may decrease the effects of warfarin sodium (e.g., co-enzyme Q 10 , St. John's wort, ginseng).

warfarinHerbal.note: 说明书没有逐味点名当归、丹参；方中活血药的出血观察另由 antithrombotic_bleeding 按知识库人群规则写。

highPotassiumFoods.sentence: 少吃香蕉、橙子、土豆、菠菜、干果、浓肉汤等含钾高的食物

source.title: National Kidney Foundation, Potassium and Your CKD Diet
source.quote: Banana (1/2 of a whole)；Orange (1 medium-sized)；Potatoes (white and sweet)；Spinach (cooked)；Dried fruits；Nuts and seeds (1 ounce)；Salt substitutes / lite salt

highPotassiumFoods.note: 高钾（血钾>5.5）时饮食段不推荐这些食物，注意事项的高钾一句加上少吃含钾高的食物。

notMedicationFoods.note: 病历里患者「吃了」的食物、自制食疗不是在用的药，不进「正在服用的药」一条（第四十六轮 new45-n03：吃了猪血被写成请把猪血连同药盒带去就医；new45-n18 梨水、川贝蒸梨）。
